  "subject": "Channel Manager Pricing for Harborview Hotel",
  "body": "Hi Anil,

Thank you for reaching out to us. I would be happy to provide pricing details for your 4 properties and help you meet your three-week timeline for selecting a channel manager.

To ensure we provide the most accurate pricing structure and verify any specific integration requirements across your locations, would you be open to a quick 10-minute introductory call this week?

Please let me know your availability for tomorrow or Thursday, or feel free to share the best time to connect.

Best regards,
Sales Team"
}
